description: The full current SPX dealer market structure, the largest realtime read: walls, gamma flip, net GEX, regime and the strike-level detail below. Current computed SPX dealer market structure (walls, gamma flip, net GEX, regime), recomputed ~every 10s during market hours: scored pressure-point strike ladder, implied 50%/80% forecast-band ranges, strike activity (volume/OI), and VIX term-structure context. Also the 0DTE ATM-straddle expected move and its session fence, max pain, the running session open/high/low with the prior close and gap, order-flow measurements, a top-10 net-GEX strike profile, and chain vanna/charm totals with a top-10 strike ladder. The full realtime structure needs a funded zdte.ai API key (no website account needed); without a key this returns a delayed headline preview (regime, spot, walls, gamma flip, net GEX). Data only -- not investment advice or a trade recommendation.
